title: PALMAX - Azimut Magellano 30M
highlights: Hull no. 1 of the Magellano 30 Metri line
World Yacht Trophies winner, Best Layout
One private family owner, turn-key condition
description:
PALMAX is the very first hull of the Azimut Magellano 30 Metri line and winner of the World Yacht Trophies for Best Layout in her class. Ken Freivokh drew her sculpted exterior, while Vincenzo De Cotiis created five elegant cabins and two luminous salons with high ceilings and vast windows.

Built to RINA class and powered by upgraded twin MAN V12 1,900 HP engines, she has only ever been used privately by one family. Lying in Sanremo, Italy, tax paid, she is offered in immaculate, turn-key condition.
